title: Metric Tapping Profile Dataset
verification_method: Hole-preparation (tap drill) values are derived by direct reference from the existing verified metric_threads dataset. Thread engagement and tapping process parameters have not been independently verified and currently carry no verification method.
license_notes: Hole-preparation values are re-derived from BoltLab's own already-reviewed metric_threads dataset; no copyrighted standards tables are reproduced. No new external source material was introduced in this phase.

derived_candidates.description: General approximation rule for tap-drill (pilot-hole) diameter prior to tapping ISO metric threads, attributed to ISO 2306:1972 (Drills for use prior to tapping screw threads). Secondary-source characterization places the resulting engagement at approximately 77% of full thread height. This is a general mathematical approximation, not a per-size lookup table value, and has NOT been cross-checked in this phase against the specific tap_drill_mm values already present in the metric_threads dataset on a record-by-record basis.
derived_candidates.note: Recorded for reference only. Existing hole_preparation.value fields in this dataset's records remain sourced by direct reference to the pre-existing verified metric_threads dataset, not by this formula. Do not use this entry to alter, override, or promote the verified status of any existing record.
